title: Kosovo War
summary: Armed conflict in Kosovo in which ethnic Albanians, led militarily by the Kosovo Liberation Army, fought Serbian and Yugoslav forces. Atrocities and ethnic cleansing displaced many Albanians. NATO air strikes began on 24 March 1999 and ended with a June peace accord, after which Kosovo came under UN administration.

as_recorded.value: On March 24 NATO began air strikes against Serbian military targets.

where.modern_name: Kosovo (proxy pin: Kosovo, the location Wikidata lists)

importance.justification: NATO intervention and ethnic cleansing reshaped the Balkans and led to UN administration and later independence.

audience_note: Describes ethnic cleansing, atrocities and mass displacement of civilians.
